title: 第十八章 异蝶奥义 黑蝠魔爪第十九章 寒冰封体 血腥屠戮
content_zh:
万青山虽以内力强封住了肩部血脉，暂时止住了血。但是刚才那股诡异的冰寒之气却是趁势钻入了他的体内，顺着大椎、胸道二处血位徐徐而下，在悬枢穴位处汇聚，然后缓缓归结于脏腑。万青山心下一惊，这股寒气的游走动向竟然与他自己研练“异蝶术”时，气穴游走部分的次顺分毫不差！“这，这竟然也是‘异蝶术’？”万青山扶着自己隐隐作痛的肩头，向着蜷缩在地、沉沉昏睡过去的虫小蝶打量过去！
几缕凌乱的发丝低垂了下来，遮住了他那张清新俊逸的脸庞，眉角似剑，鼻挺若峰。而在发丝间隙里浅浅露着他侧脸的一颗小酒窝，让人感觉有说不出的可爱。少年独特的冷峻气质再加上些许孩子气的顽皮，让这个男孩看上去愈发的可人，叫人顿生怜爱之意。
随着眼神的游走，万青山的双眼落在了虫小蝶的胳膊上，嫩生生而白皙的肌肤，在阴冷昏暗的烛火里面显得格外引人瞩目。虽然虫小蝶的身体刚刚经历了一次**的幻化，而且这个过程又是那么的痛苦，但现在虫小蝶的慵睡之态很是惬意，只见他沐浴在那令人颤抖的冰冷寒气之中，胸脯竟然起伏有顺，呼吸均匀，丝毫没有受到寒冷侵蚀的影响！这就更让万青山感到不可思议了！
万青山转念思索着刚才侵入自己内腑的那股冰寒之气，虽然还没完全凝炼成形，未达到“异蝶术”中级奥义所要求的的冰封周天，冻凝天罡的地步，但是已然有了霜打脏腑，雪冷经脉的恐怖力量！更为奇怪的是，这个孩童看上去只有十七八岁，哪来的内力去支撑如此强大的‘异蝶术’啊？
随后，他带着满是疑窦的神情继续打量过去。只一眼，便瞥见了那只静静蛰伏在蝴蝶纹身处的小虫子，胖嘟嘟的身体，晶莹剔透的质地，周身还氤氲着一圈圈纤白的冷气。虫子身下的那片蝴蝶纹身被纹刻得栩栩如生，活灵活现，现在正自荧荧发亮，闪着怪异的光芒。而那一行细小的梵文就像一条好看的带子将美丽的蝴蝶牢牢地系在了虫小蝶的胳膊上一般。
传言，每个桑梭族人的臂膀上都刺有蝴蝶纹身，据说刺刻纹身的针石是用桑梭族人口中被奉为神灵的圣祖——木达尔的舍利打磨而成的。关于这个蝴蝶纹身的意义，桑梭族人一直守口如瓶，连万青山也不得而知。只是在他们愈是遮掩得神秘，其纹身背后的意义就愈加显得神乎其神。
万青山凝神呆望了会，然后回想了下刚才虫小蝶的怪异举动，点了点头，心中暗道：“难怪桑梭族人要把‘白玉观音’称之为‘圣灵’，原来它本就是一个活物。而且这个活物是需要用桑梭族人的本族之血来唤醒的！当它被唤醒后，接触蝴蝶纹身时，就会爆发出极其恐怖的力量。”
所谓的桑梭族“圣灵”其实就是一只晶莹剔透的、胖乎乎的蛹虫，它一直蛰伏在一块似美玉一般无暇透明的蛹里一动也不动，沉沉地睡着。
这一睡就是历经百年，虽然其间被异手多次，但它的神秘面纱却从未被揭开过。而关于“圣灵”与“异蝶术”之间的联系也更是无人知晓。而就在今天，万青山却在无意之中亲眼目睹了“圣灵”的真实面目，得知了它的奥秘所在。但是在万青山的脸上却看不到任何的欣喜之色，他只是微微地点了点头。
时间洗净铅华，岁月涤荡往事。曾经无数武林人士为了夺取“圣灵”而挑起了一波又一波的厮杀，江湖中数起骇人听闻的灭门血案无不与“圣灵”有着千丝万缕的联系。这一场血雨腥风的浩劫在百年之前就开始了，持续了近数十年之久！江湖纷扰，乱如牛毛。倏而骤风急雨，风声鹤唳。倏而雨住风收，丽日出云。动荡数十年的干戈争执刚刚放下，少有的太平初入中原武林。万青山不由得叹了一口气，默道：“树欲静而风不止，江湖永远没有平静的时候！”
“圣灵”如此地神秘，甚至连手握至宝的桑梭族人对于如何解开“圣灵”奥秘都毫无头绪！而万青山在目睹谜底解开的这一刻，却显得颇为冷静，因为他觉得这个谜底似乎过于简单了，简单的让他寄托的所有无限遐想瞬间崩塌！现在的他只是觉得很好笑，替那些葬身在乱刀之下，追逐“圣灵”的人感到万分的不值！
万青山收敛了无奈的苦笑，仔细的推敲琢磨。头脑熟路的他凭着多年的阅历和大胆的猜想，已把“圣灵”的奥秘以及与“异蝶术”的联系大致参透理解。他心底雪亮，眼中光棱一闪。
只见万青山屏气凝神，蹑手蹑脚地向虫小蝶走去。他慢慢俯下身来，眼睛一眨不眨地盯着那只胖乎乎的小虫子，眼神里充满了贪婪！随后，他颤抖地伸出右手，用中指抹了抹臂膀上的血渍，然后曲起手腕费力地在他的左手手背上画了一道灵符，口中念念作声。
随后他深提一口气，运转周天。只见他的印堂徐徐变暗，背后阴风鼓荡，一股黑气缓缓从其背后爬窜出来，将其左手紧紧包裹完全，“咔、咔。。。”骤听得几声骨骼撕磨的声音，万青山的左手竟幻化为一只青毛黑爪，壮硕有力。随后又一声“喀嚓”声传来，只见那只怪爪兀地一缩，五只锐利似剑的爪勾便凸现出来，锋芒毕露，熠熠闪着寒光，真就如蝙蝠的利爪一般！
万青山刚才休憩片刻，汇聚内力养伤培元，自忖着自己武基深厚，内力不绝，身体还有几分劲力，便运起“异蝶术”一爪向虫小蝶的臂膀上爪去。
“哧、哧。。。”一阵刺耳嘈杂，一阵光棱溅射。利爪触碰到虫小蝶的臂膀，就如同抓挠着一块表面光滑，质地极其坚硬的寒冰一般，毫无效果！
content_en:
Although Wan Qingshan used his internal strength to seal the blood veins in his shoulder, he temporarily stopped the bleeding. But the strange cold air just now took advantage of the situation and penetrated into his body. It slowly flowed down the blood levels in Dazhui and chest, gathered at the Xuanshu acupuncture point, and then slowly returned to the internal organs. Wan Qingshan was shocked. The movement of this cold air was exactly the same as when he was practicing the "Exotic Butterfly Technique". "This, this is also the 'Alien Butterfly Technique'?" Wan Qingshan held his aching shoulder and looked at Chong Xiaodie who was curled up on the ground and sleeping deeply!
A few messy strands of hair hung down, covering his fresh and handsome face. His eyebrows were like swords and his nose was as straight as a peak. And a small dimple on his side face is slightly exposed in the gap between the hair, which makes people feel indescribably cute. The young man's unique cold temperament coupled with a bit of childish naughtiness makes this boy look even more lovely, making people feel affectionate.
As his eyes wandered, Wan Qingshan's eyes fell on Chong Xiaodie's arm. The tender and fair skin looked particularly eye-catching in the cold and dim candlelight. Although Chong Xiaodie's body has just experienced a sexual transformation, and the process was so painful, Chong Xiaodie's sleepy state is very comfortable now. He is bathed in the trembling cold air, his chest rises and falls smoothly, his breathing is even, and he is not affected by the cold erosion at all! This makes Wanqingshan even more incredible!
Wan Qingshan then thought about the icy air that invaded his inner organs just now. Although it has not yet completely condensed and formed, and has not reached the point of freezing the sky and freezing the heavens required by the intermediate secret of "Alien Butterfly Technique", it already has the terrifying power of frost hitting the internal organs and freezing the meridians! What's even more strange is that this child looks to be only seventeen or eighteen years old. How can he have the internal strength to support such a powerful 'Alien Butterfly Technique'?
Then, he continued to look at it with a suspicious expression. With just one glance, I caught a glimpse of the little bug quietly dormant in the butterfly tattoo, with its chubby body, crystal clear texture, and circles of delicate white air-conditioning surrounding it. The butterfly tattoo under the insect's body was carved vividly and vividly, and was now shining with a strange light. And that small line of Sanskrit was like a beautiful belt that tightly tied the beautiful butterfly to Chong Xiaodie's arm.
Rumor has it that every Sansuo tribe member has a butterfly tattoo on their arm. It is said that the needle stone used to carve the tattoo was polished with the relics of Mudar, the ancestor of the Sansuo tribe who is regarded as a god. Regarding the meaning of this butterfly tattoo, the Sansuo people have been tight-lipped, and even Wanqingshan does not know. But the more mysterious they are, the more mysterious the meaning behind their tattoos becomes.
Wan Qingshan stared attentively for a while, then recalled Chong Xiaodie's strange behavior just now, nodded, and said to himself: "No wonder the Sansuo people call the 'White Jade Guanyin' the 'Holy Spirit'. It turns out that it is a living creature. And this living creature needs to be awakened with the blood of the Sansuo people! When it is awakened and touches the butterfly tattoo, it will explode with extremely terrifying power."
The so-called "Holy Spirit" of the Sansuo people is actually a crystal clear, chubby chrysalis. It has been dormant in a jade-like flawless and transparent pupa, motionless and sleeping deeply.
This sleep lasted for hundreds of years. Although it was changed hands many times during this period, its mystery has never been revealed. And no one knows about the connection between the "Holy Spirit" and the "Alien Butterfly Technique". But today, Wan Qingshan inadvertently witnessed the true face of the "Holy Spirit" and learned its mystery. But there was no joy on Wan Qingshan's face. He just nodded slightly.
time to washPure lead, time washes away the past. In the past, countless martial arts practitioners provoked waves of killings in order to seize the "Holy Spirit". Several shocking murders in the world were all inextricably linked to the "Holy Spirit". This bloody catastrophe started a hundred years ago and lasted for nearly several decades! The rivers and lakes are in turmoil and chaos. Suddenly the wind and rain suddenly came, and the wind roared. Suddenly the rain stops and the wind collects, and the beautiful sun rises with clouds. Decades of turbulent wars and disputes have just been put aside, and rare peace has entered the martial arts world of the Central Plains. Wan Qingshan couldn't help but sigh and said silently: "The trees want to be quiet but the wind doesn't stop, the rivers and lakes will never be calm!"
The "Holy Spirit" is so mysterious that even the Sansuo people who hold the treasure have no clue how to unlock the mystery of the "Holy Spirit"! But Wan Qingshan seemed quite calm at the moment when he saw the answer to the mystery being solved, because he felt that the answer seemed to be too simple, and the simplicity caused all the infinite reveries he had placed on him to collapse instantly! Now he just thinks it's funny and feels extremely worthless for those who were killed by the sword and chased the "Holy Spirit"!
Wan Qingshan suppressed his helpless smile and considered it carefully. With his many years of experience and bold conjectures, he has a familiar mind and has a thorough understanding of the mystery of the "Holy Spirit" and its connection with the "Alien Butterfly Art". His heart was clear and his eyes were gleaming.
I saw Wanqingshan holding his breath and concentrating, tiptoeing towards Chong Xiaodie. He slowly leaned down and stared at the chubby little insect without blinking, his eyes full of greed! Then, he stretched out his right hand tremblingly, wiped the blood on his arm with his middle finger, then bent his wrist and drew a talisman on the back of his left hand with great effort, chanting in his mouth.
Then he took a deep breath and started to move around. I saw his Yintang slowly darkening, a dark wind blowing behind him, and a black air slowly crawled out from behind, tightly wrapping his left hand completely, "Ka, Ka..." Suddenly, after hearing several sounds of bone tearing, Wan Qingshan's left hand turned into a green-haired black claw, strong and powerful. Then another "click" sound came, and the monster's claws shrank suddenly, and five sharp sword-like claws protruded. They were sharp and shining with cold light, just like the claws of a bat!
Wan Qingshan had just rested for a moment, concentrating his internal energy to recuperate and build up his strength. Thinking that he had a strong martial arts base, endless internal energy, and still had some strength in his body, he used the "Alien Butterfly Technique" to claw at Chong Xiaodie's arm.
"Chi, chi..." There was a harsh noise, and a burst of light sputtered. When the sharp claws touched Chong Xiaodie's arm, it was like scratching a piece of ice with a smooth surface and extremely hard texture. It had no effect!
